QuestInfo.name: Path of the Sage 3
QuestInfo.0: It seemed the training would never stop. The trip to #m324000000# was proving taxing, but the Goddess Teardrop was supposed to be nearby. If only they could convince #b#p2440001##k to let them pass.
QuestInfo.1: #p2440001# has offered the duo an official trainee title. They'd need to traverse the long wooden bridge to #m324090040# to train with #b#p2440018##k.\r\n\r\n #r(Tip: Forfeit the quest if you need to restart.)#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2440001# seemed to be pleased when Alpha and Beta actually passed their tests. Could the life of a monk have been their true calling?

1.0: All right, all right. Maybe you two have some skills. I mean, #bAran#k finished the lesson in about half the time, but you kids are okay.
1.1: You came here as arrogant children, and with my tutelage, you may actually become terrible monks.
